title: FINRA Reg SHO daily short-sale volume, one row per (trade_date, symbol) (schema_version 1)
description: One row of fundamentals_pit/short_volume/v1/months/{YYYY-MM}.parquet. Producer: collectors/short_volume_pit.py (collect_month). Short-sale VOLUME on TRF/ADF-reported trades, not short interest. PRODUCER TEST: tests/test_pit_dataset_contracts.py. alpha-engine-config-I12567 (DATA-01, second slice).

trade_date.description: The trade date the FINRA file covers; also the availability date under FINRA's publication rule.

symbol.description: FINRA's symbol on the trade date (provider alias, alpha-engine-config-I12568).

short_exempt_volume.description: null on a file whose layout carries no ShortExemptVolume column.

source.description: Which FINRA file served the day (consolidated or per-facility fallback).

x-pit.rule: FINRA publishes a trade date's file by 6 pm ET that day. That is a published rule; the per-file publication instant is not observed. So a row is admissible for session S only when trade_date < S. Declared final: FINRA's file for a past trade date is not a revised series, and a month already written is skipped on later runs unless --overwrite is passed. If FINRA re-issues a day's file, --overwrite replaces the row in place, and this declaration must then become 'overwritten'.
